title: BuyerCriteria - Data API
description: Represents the buyer context qualifier of locale for any buyer groups of type Market This object is available in API version 58.0 and later.

CriteriaKey.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CriteriaKey.description: The label displayed to list supported markets with associated languages and currencies. Possible values are: Locale DataCloudSegment

CriteriaKeyType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CriteriaKeyType.description: Defines the type of key. Possible values are: SessionAttributes Session Attributes DataCloudObjects

CriteriaValue.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update, Nillable
CriteriaValue.description: The value of a Locale. For example, fr-FR.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: Optional. Three letter ISO currency codes associated with the buyer account record or a locale. Auto populated if MultiCurrency is enabled in org.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Description.description: The supported criteria in this record.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate is not null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The name of the buyer group the criteria apply to.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: ID of the member group or Admin/Merchandiser . This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

usage: BuyerCriteria is related to objects that enable a localized buyer experience. Together, these objects provide buyers with dynamic access to the qualifiers (entitlements, price books, and promotions) associated with their buyer group when they browse and shop in webstores with localized languages and currencies. The related objects are as follows:
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **BuyerCriteriaFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **BuyerCriteriaHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **BuyerCriteriaOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **BuyerCriteriaShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
